requirement: Trim an over-long Claude conversation from the oldest turn so the request plus an output reserve fits the context budget, without orphaning tool results.
skeleton: A TokenCounter Protocol, a BudgetError, _is_tool_result and _can_start helpers, and fit_history searching suffixes with count_tokens.
caption: A Claude context trimmer written in the standard library with a typing Protocol for client.messages.count_tokens and no third-party imports. fit_history counts the system prompt plus each candidate suffix and returns the longest suffix whose input_tokens fit budget minus reserve, dropping the oldest turns first and only starting at a plain user turn so a tool_result never loses its tool_use. BudgetError, a ValueError subclass, is raised for a reserve that is negative or not below the budget, a history that is empty or not ending with a user turn, or a last turn that alone does not fit. The fixture asserts full fits, exact fits, dropped turns, tool_result handling and every BudgetError case.

plan.intent: Fit history into a token budget
constraints: The window fits budget minus reserve, inclusive
The oldest turns are dropped first
A window starts at a user turn that is not a tool_result
An empty history or one not ending with a user turn raises BudgetError
A reserve that is negative or not below the budget raises BudgetError
A last turn that alone does not fit raises BudgetError

rationale.teaches: Count real tokens with the API for each suffix, reserve room for the reply, and advance only to safe turn boundaries.
rationale.why: Cutting at arbitrary messages orphans tool_result blocks or leaves no room for the answer, and the API rejects the request.

ops.docstring: Trim a Claude conversation from the front until it fits a token budget.

ops.source:
class BudgetError(ValueError):
    """The conversation cannot be made to fit the budget."""

def _can_start(message: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return message["role"] == "user" and not _is_tool_result(message)

candidates.why_wrong: A window that fits the limit exactly is rejected.
The output reserve is ignored, so the reply has no room.
The window can start at a tool_result that lost its tool_use.
A history ending with an assistant turn is accepted.
An empty window is returned instead of raising BudgetError.
